[[Tinker Town]] | language = Common, Gnomish | theater = | members = | quartermaster = {{RaceIcon|Gnome|Male}} [[Axis Spinpistol]] | rewards = [[Mechanostrider]] mounts (rare and epic) | affiliation = [[Alliance]] | status = Active | tabard = Gnomeregan Tabard.jpg |caption=Icon of Technology}}The '''Gnomeregan Exiles''' are the faction of gnomes who were exiled from their home, [[Gnomeregan]], in [[Dun Morogh]]. Though High Tinker [[Gelbin Mekkatorque]], leader of the gnomes, had temporarily had to settle down in [[Tinker Town]] after the fall of Gnomeregan, the gnomes have since reclaimed an old factory that has been refurbished into the [[Gnomeregan Reclamation Facility]] to serve as new quarters for the gnomish people. ==Reputation== [[Bubulo Acerbus]] has the repeatable cloth quests to achieve a higher reputation with Gnomeregan Exiles. In return for exalted reputation, non-gnome players are able to ride [[mechanostrider]]s. The zones of [[Dun Morogh]], [[Stonetalon Mountains]] and [[Azshara]] offer many quests for gaining reputation with the Gnomeregan Exiles. ==Rewards== At exalted, [[Axis Spinpistol]] offers a tabard and a set of unique [[Engineering|engineer]]-exclusive epic scrapforged mechaspider mounts, and non-gnomish Alliance races are able to purchase and ride mechanostriders mounts (gnomes can ride Gnomeregan mechanostriders regardless of faction reputation). Gnomeregan mechanostriders are bought from [[Milli Featherwhistle]] at [[Steelgril's Depot]], northeast of [[Kharanos]] in [[Dun Morogh]]. Regular mechanostriders are available starting at level 40, with turbo mechanostriders available at level 60. {| class="fandom-table" ! !! Item !! Cost !!
